summary: On July 31, 2026, Griffon Corporation closed the sale of its AMES Australasia business to a joint venture formed with HupCo ParentCo Pty Ltd, an investment group led by AMES Australasia management with Australian financial investors. Griffon HoldCo, a wholly owned subsidiary, sold its interest and received a PIK Note issued by HupCo TopCo Pty Ltd. Griffon retains a 49% equity stake in the joint venture. A side letter novates Griffon HoldCo's rights to other Griffon subsidiaries, advances debt-financing fees to be reimbursed, and delays an independent director nomination to within 30 business days post-closing, with a four-member interim board. Watch for the valuation implied by the PIK Note and future reimbursement payments.
